title: The Eye
journal: Beyond the guardian's hall lies the Root, where the roots of every Hist meet, and the Eye of Argonia sits among them. Used where it sits, it heals every tree; lifted, it parts them for good. What I do with it is mine to decide.
objectives: Go to the Eye of Argonia in the Root's chamber. (marker: The Eye of Argonia)

plan.going: The Root is where the roots of every Hist meet. The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits among them: used where it sits, it heals every tree; lifted, it parts them for good. the guardian is dead; the Eye is through the far door
plan.ways: I already know the choice: use it as the order ordered, take it, or (if Cuts-the-Old-Knot lives) let her lift it

answers: I am in Black Marsh after setting the seal-stones and killing the hydra guardian. The Eye of Argonia sits in the Root; it can heal the trees in place (but the order can see through them) or be lifted (ends the dreams, kills about three in ten trees).
Go to the Eye of Argonia in the Root chamber, through the door at the far end of Guardian Hall.
Use the Eye in place, or lift it; or first check the Fort Chalkmoth cellar claim about dreamers, or loot the hydra treasure.
I do not know who exactly the order is, nor Ennodius Vanin the Collector; I could ask people or check the journal.

title: The Eye
journal: I laid my hand on the Eye of Argonia. Now I must choose what to do with it.
objectives: Choose what to do with the Eye of Argonia. (marker: The Eye of Argonia)

plan.going: the choice is in front of me on the message box
plan.ways: use (heals all trees; the order's rule made fast; Cuts-the-Old-Knot dies; I get Toh-Nassa, a keep, training, stronger blessings; the Unbound hunt me); take (trees part, three in ten die, dreams end; I get the Eye and Knot-Breaker, the Unbound's highest rank; the order hunts me; no more blessings); give (the same parting; she keeps the Eye; I get her as an ally, her spells and the Karsh-Naal longhouse)

answers: I am at the Root with my hand on the Eye. I must decide its fate. Using it heals all trees but locks in the order rule and its dreamers, and Cuts-the-Old-Knot dies. Taking or giving it kills about three in ten trees with their villages, ends the dreams and breaks the order.
Choose one of the three buttons here at the Root.
Use it; take it myself (no Hist will bless me, the order hunts me); or give it to Cuts-the-Old-Knot (same deaths, she stands with me).
I do not understand how Cuts-the-Old-Knot is alive here when I killed her, nor whether her claim about dreamers in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar is true. I could not verify it.

title: The Eye
journal: I used the Eye where it sits. I saw the trees of the marsh heal, every one. Cuts-the-Old-Knot died of it in the guardian's hall: the sap she drank carried the Eye's power through her. The Kings' Gate gave the three stones back to me as it closed. Never-Writes-Twice wants them back, in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom. (marker: Never-Writes-Twice)

plan.going: I healed every tree; the order's dreamers see through them again; the Unbound will now attack me on sight
plan.next: bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom for the order's highest rank
plan.ways: none; the hand-in is the step

answers: I used the Eye in place. All trees healed, no trees died, but the Xeech-Leel order rule is made fast and its dreamers in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar see through every tree again. Cuts-the-Old-Knot died. The gate returned the three seal-stones to me.
Bring the three stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom.
Deliver them as asked, or look into Fort Chalkmoth cellar first, or keep the stones.
I do not know what Unbound being hostile to me means or who they are, nor what Never-Writes-Twice wants the stones for. I could ask her.

title: The Eye
journal: I gave the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice. She made me Toh-Nassa, Leader of the Secret, and gave me the keep of Fort Chalkmoth for my house. The dreamers sleep in the cellar beneath it.

plan.going: I gave the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice. She made me Toh-Nassa, Leader of the Secret, and gave me the keep of Fort Chalkmoth for my house. The dreamers sleep in the cellar beneath it.
plan.next: nothing more in this quest; the next quests entry carries the step

answers: Quest The Eye is complete. I used the Eye in place: all trees healed, none died, the Xeech-Leel order rule is made fast and its dreamers see through every tree again. Cuts-the-Old-Knot died from the sap. I gave the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom; she named me Toh-Nassa, Leader of the Secret, and gave me the Keep of Fort Chalkmoth.
Nothing is required. Optionally visit Fort Chalkmoth, its smith and trainer, and check the cellar dreamers myself.
Go to Fort Chalkmoth; ask Never-Writes-Twice about the order ranks and the Root; loot the hydra treasure; find Ennodius Vanin the Collector.
Unverified: whether the dreamers in the cellar are truly captives as Cuts-the-Old-Knot claimed, and why the Unbound are hostile to me. I would find out by visiting the cellar.
